title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 me Hipoteke ne Don Bosko. Cmimi 155.000 Euro
description_sq:

Apartamenti ndodhet ne pallat te ri me ashensor

title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale with mortgage in Don Bosco. The price is 155,000 Euros
description_en: In Don Bosco, near Viva Market, 2+1 apartment with mortgage and furnished is for sale. The apartment is located in a new building with an elevator. It is organized by living room + kitchen, corridor, two bedrooms, two balconies and a bathroom.
